question: On an STM32F103x8/xB, after updating the independent watchdog settings and immediately entering Stop mode, the next watchdog update hangs and eventually resets the MCU. How can this be prevented?

generation.answer: To prevent this issue, ensure that the independent watchdog counter is frozen in debug mode before entering Stop mode. This can be achieved by setting the appropriate bit in the option bytes of the STM32F103x8/xB device. Refer to the section on "Independent watchdog" in the STM32F103x8/xB datasheet for more details on how to configure the watchdog settings correctly. [Page 3]
